channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's clearest win is a $227.6 million federally-backed modernization of the Tren Urbano, alongside steady DDEC incentive uptake for water-impacted businesses and modest organic growth signals (an insurance-services expansion, an aviation-catering certification, a $2.5M university renovation) plus a bullish 5G-adoption outlook. The dominant risk theme remains Puerto Rico's drought and water crisis, which is drawing sustained congressional criticism over $30 billion in undisbursed federal disaster funds and forcing emergency AAA spending, without yet converting into committed new infrastructure investment.
